_comment: Build-time overrides for scripts/gtfs-shapes.mjs (npm run build:network). JSON carries no comments, so this key holds the file's purpose, the way scripts/zet-schema-overrides.json's allowlists carry a reason per entry. unreachableStops: platforms a shapeless tram pattern calls at that lie further than SERVED_STOP_MAX_METRES (60 m) from every rail edge the feed's shapes draw, and that are not a first or last stop the TERMINUS_STOP_MAX_METRES (200 m) override already reaches. Without an entry here such a stop FAILS the build by name, because an interior stop off the rails is normally a wrong coordinate or a missing shape, not something to route past silently. An entry says the stop is genuinely off the graph and the synthetic path should be routed past it: the path will neither run to it nor serve it. Each entry is { id, name, reason } -- the id is what matches, the name is for the reader. On feed 000395 the list is empty: every stop of every shapeless tram pattern is within 60 m of a rail once the router reads the served radius (F8b).
